skill_name: Compare and contrast playing an instrument to playing a sport.
workflow: Both playing an instrument and playing a sport involve physical and mental activities. Playing an instrument requires an understanding of musical notation, technical ability and a mastery of the instrument itself. It also demands a deep emotional understanding and interpretation of the music. Playing a sport, on the other hand, requires learning basic skills and then honing them to a high level of expertise.
